title: Second-degree heart block
summary: Every other P wave is not followed by a QRS: a 2:1 heart block.
description: Here conduction from the atria to the ventricles fails at times. At first every P wave is followed by a QRS (these beats are also wide, from a right bundle branch block: R). Then only every other P wave is conducted (a 2:1 block): the P waves that are not conducted are marked, and the ventricles beat at half the rate of the atria. Later, every P wave is conducted again.
look_for: The P waves keep a regular rhythm throughout
The P waves that are not followed by a QRS (marked 'blocked P')
The ventricular rate during the 2:1 block, compared with the atrial rate
